name: Almazán (Spain)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Almazán (a tree on red between hearts, within a green wreath with a pendant).
history: Municipal flag of Almazán; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
